text:
jess (marketing): ok team — quick thread for the London roadshow next month. need to lock booth rotations, microsession speakers, and swag pick-up windows. who can own what? :raising_hand:

austin (events): i can own the booth schedule and power/distro checklist. will post a draft tomorrow.

zoe (distro): swag inventory is low on stickers and tees (S/M). ordering ETA if we push today is 7 business days.

micah (growth): can we reduce tee counts to avoid waste? propose: 60 tees, 200 stickers, 150 postcards. run with promo code postcard QR.

lee (logistics): note — venue only allows deliveries Mon-Fri 9-5. any Saturday deliveries will be refused. shipping labels must include event PO: INV-LLN-0426.

jess (marketing): good call micah. zoe please confirm cost delta if we drop to 60 tees. also need someone to confirm demo laptop and HDMI switch.

zoe (distro): cost delta: tees 120 -> 90 GBP each total + lead time same. stickers negligible. updated spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1RoadshowSwag

micah (growth): fine on tees. can we add 2 premium demo invite slots for customers (sign-up QR at booth)? keeps talk exclusive.

lee (logistics): demo laptop + dongles — austin, do you have the backup laptop checklist? otherwise i can bring a spare HDMI switch and a USB-C dongle.

austin (events): i will bring the checklist and a spare Macbook. also booking a small rolling case for swag so we don't need a van.

jess (marketing): speakers — we have 3 microslots (10m each). ask speakers to upload slides to the shared folder 24h prior. micah, can you confirm speaker names and cadence?

micah (growth): confirmed: Lina P., Omar K., and Rina T. cadence: 11:15, 12:00, 15:30. Lina needs a lav mic. Omar wants a short demo, 10 min. Rina wants 5 extra slides.

zoe (distro): placing the order now for stickers + tees (60). will add 50 extra postcards. ETA 7 business days.

jamie-bot: shipping label created: INV-LLN-0426 | carrier: FastShip | tracking: FS123456789GB (will update on pickup).

lee (logistics): action items: 1) zoe: submit order (today), 2) austin: upload booth plan + power diagram (tomorrow), 3) micah: collect speaker slides and upload (3 days), 4) jess: finalize lead routing form and post-event nurture flow.

jess (marketing): routing: leads go to sales-inbound first, high-intent flagged to enterprise queue. micah will triage for outbound. Also we need a lead-capture QR that writes to HubSpot and tags event=roadshow-london.

micah (growth): will set up HubSpot form and QR. can we use short URL redwood.ai/road-lln?

austin (events): yes. also we should print a tiny badge with the QR and "Demo sign-up" to stick on the booth table.

zoe (distro): reminder — don't pack fragile enamel pins with tees. ship separately in bubble.

lee (logistics): shipping window: earliest pickup Tue 04/30, latest Wed 05/01 to guarantee venue delivery Mon 05/06. if labels aren't ready, we'll miss the slot.

jess (marketing): final ask: can everyone react with :thumbsup: when their part is actually done so we can close the thread? i'll follow up with a short checklist doc.

micah (growth): :thumbsup:

zoe (distro): :thumbsup:

lee (logistics): :thumbsup:

avait (contractor): quick q — where do i drop the banner vinyl for printing approvals?

jess (marketing): @avait drop in the shared art folder and ping design for a quick review. design has 24h SLA.

jamie-bot: Reminder scheduled: deliverables due in 72 hours.
